description: This file defines a JPA attribute converter class 'ExternalIdConverter' used to convert between 'ExternalId' objects and their String representations for database persistence. It is part of the 'org.apache.fineract.investor.domain' package and implements conversion logic in a typical Java Persistence API (JPA) manner.

classes.name: ExternalIdConverter
classes.description: A JPA attribute converter that transforms 'ExternalId' objects to Strings for database storage, and vice versa.

methods.name: convertToDatabaseColumn
methods.description: Converts an ExternalId object to its String representation for database storage.

methods.name: convertToEntityAttribute
methods.description: Converts a String from the database to an ExternalId object.
